title: Follow the Rules (or Not): Community Norms and AI-Generated Support in Online Health Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM-as-a-judge (Llama-3) and expert qualitative review to evaluate whether GPT-4 generated responses conform to community norms by avoiding derogatory, shaming, or stigmatizing language (e.g., using terms like 'addict' or 'clean') directed at individuals recovering from opioid use disorder.
